# `tailwind-v3` — Tailwind v3 identified by its config file

- **Pre-state, measured at `c7e82087e`:** `axes.css: tailwind` (one value for
  both majors).
- **Post-state (Phase 2.3):** `axes.css: tailwind-v3`.

The marker is `tailwind.config.*`, not a version string: Phase 2.3 writes no
version into any skill, it only makes the axis able to carry the distinction
that `road-to-component-library-lifecycle` Phase 5.2 keys on.
